desc: Audit the two surviving mechanism families for the multi-core fail-stop fault: page lifetime/refcount reuse and TLB-invalidation completion. Grounding: NEXT_STEPS §1, ROADMAP §C, and completed tickets 207/208, which refuted copy_highpage ordering while leaving a kernel-mode fault on a valid linear-map address. Trace the exact arm64 fork/write-fault page lifecycle and TLBI broadcast path in the pinned Wallace kernel; compare T6040 MIDR/revision handling, secondary-CPU feature setup, and applicable arm64 errata hooks with the closest upstream-supported Apple generation. Deliver a source-line matrix, config/commit pins, and either a narrowly evidenced patch draft or a recorded no-go. No rig work and no timing perturbation may be presented as a fix.
author: sol
